what: Comet plot for paired or multi-step measurements from a phyloseq object — comet_pq
title: Comet plot for paired or multi-step measurements from a phyloseq object — comet_pq
text: comet plot (also called tapered-line slope arrow plot) visualises paired multi-step continuous measurements observational unit. linewidth-tapered segment (path) connects origin destination: narrow end origin wide end destination. Vocabulary comet full path drawn one observational unit. defined sequence (x, y, modality_level) observations sharing id value. id level defines exactly one comet. step one node (x, y) along comet, corresponding one level modality ordered factor. Duplicate modality levels within id allowed. tail first step (smallest modality level); tip last step (largest modality level). path tapers thin tail thick tip. Two interfaces supported: Wide format (x_start, x_end, y_start, y_end): row data holds start end coordinates. Uses ggforce::geom_link() draw single tapered segment per row. Long format (x, y, modality, id): row holds one measurement one observational unit one modality level. modality must ordered factor 2 levels; id identifies unit. Uses ggforce::geom_link2() linewidth tapers continuously across steps (independently per segment), enabling timeline-style multi-step comets. Inspired Armstrong 2014 (IEEE VIS) zanarmstrong's gist https://gist.github.com/zanarmstrong/6c2855a34f504029847485c690692e75. function accepts either plain data.frame phyloseq::phyloseq object. phyloseq object supplied, sample metadata used result overview plot sample level.

what: Ternary and diamond plots for 3-or-4-group taxon compositions — ternary_pq
title: Ternary and diamond plots for 3-or-4-group taxon compositions — ternary_pq
text: Displays taxon point inside triangle (3 groups) diamond (4 groups) whose corners represent sample groups. taxon plotted near one corner abundant group. coordinate math follows standard de Finetti diagram (Wikipedia: Ternary plot): $$x = \frac{2b + c}{2(+b+c)}, \quad y = \frac{\sqrt{3}\,c}{2(+b+c)}$$ \(,b,c\) mean relative abundances left, right, top groups respectively. diamond projection 4 groups uses: $$x = \frac{- c}{+b+c+d}, \quad y = \frac{b - d}{+b+c+d}$$ (right, top, left, bottom). independent implementation; coordinate formulas public domain (de Finetti 1926; see also Armstrong 2014, IEEE VIS).

NULL, natural factor level order used. raw (logical, default FALSE) TRUE, raw counts used instead relative abundances. normalize_groups (logical, default TRUE) TRUE (raw = FALSE), group given equal weight regardless sample count. FALSE, weight proportional sample count. color_rank (character, default NULL) Column name @tax_table map point colour. size_by (character, default "abundance") scale point size. One "abundance" (overall relative abundance), "log10_abundance", "equal" (size). label_by (character, default NULL) Column name @tax_table ("taxon" row names) annotate points text labels. label_size (numeric, default 2.5) Text size labels. add_grid (logical, default TRUE) TRUE, 10-interval reference grid drawn inside triangle / diamond. point_alpha (numeric, default 0.8) Transparency points.

metrics pluggable via make_sharing_metric() default_sharing_metrics(). default_sharing_metrics() returns four built-sharing metrics (shared species, Bray-Curtis similarity, Jaccard similarity, proportion shared genera) used community_sharing_plot(). gg_bubbles_pq() produces circle-packed bubble plot taxa abundances (circle area ∝ sequence count); supports circular square layouts, optional faceting sample variable, taxon labelling, contour colour taxonomic rank, pairwise diff_contour comparison panels; migrated comparpq (single-phyloseq variant — list_phyloseq support remains comparpq::gg_bubbles_pq()). idest_colors() returns vector colors one IdEst palettes (continuous discrete, direction override-order options), migrated taxinfo. idest_pal named list IdEst color palettes (all_color_idest, ligth_color_idest, dark_color_idest, Picabia, Picasso, Levine2, Rattner, Sidhu, Hokusai2, Hokusai3), migrated taxinfo. make_sharing_metric() builds custom community-similarity metric definition (label, colour, function, format, optional prep step bounds) use community_sharing_plot() community_sharing_barplot(). palette_earthtones() derives colour palette geographic location (latitude/longitude) downloading satellite tiles via maptiles clustering pixel RGB values k-means; works around latitude-invariance bug upstream earthtones ≤ 0.2.0 computing bounding box EPSG:3857. plot_sample_depth_pq() draws bar density plot per-sample sequencing depth, optional log10 transform, color-grouping, sort, threshold reference line; useful QA plot. plot_tax_count_pq() non-proportion variant MiscMetabar::plot_tax_pq(): counts chosen taxonomic rank stacked per sample without normalised percentages, useful spike-biomass comparisons. plot_taxa_heatmap_pq() draws heatmap n_top abundant taxa across samples, optional log10 transform custom fill scale; aggregated chosen taxonomic rank. reorder_distinct_colors() reorders discrete fill color scales ggplot maximise perceptual contrast adjacent segments, optional alternate_lightness colorblind (deuteranopia) modes;
